configuration_map: No geometric configuration. All entities (a, b, c, d, r) are magnitudes/lengths. The proof reasons entirely about commensurability relations, ratios of squares, area applications to a rational line, and classification of apotome orders. No points are positioned in space, no rays are ordered, no angles are decomposed.
skip_reason: Purely algebraic proof about classification of irrational magnitudes (apotomes of medial straight lines). The proof operates entirely through commensurability relations, ratios, fourth proportionals, and irrational number taxonomy (Props 10.92, 10.93, 10.98, 10.99, 10.103). No geometric configuration claims — no point positions, no ray orderings, no angle decompositions, no inside/outside arguments.
